steps.name: LocPref 150 - r2's route wins
steps.run: vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c 'route-map LOW-LP permit 10' -c 'set local-preference 150' -c 'end' -c 'clear ip bgp 10.10.0.20 soft in'

steps.name: r1 eth1 down - r2 lost, r3 takes over
r1 eth1 restored - r2 best again
steps.run: ip link set eth1 up && vtysh -c 'clear ip bgp 10.10.0.20'
